name: Expedia Travel
description: Live hotel, resort, vacation rental, and flight search via Expedia

default_pos_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for point-of-sale pricing.

default_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code override (omit to use adapter default).

request_timeout_ms.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds (adapter upstream calls may take 5-10s).

synthetic_mode.description: When true, sends X-Adapter-Mode: synthetic header for deterministic test data. Set to false for live upstream results.
